caption:
🚄 One day of trains in France — 24 hours, every service.

9,455 scheduled services across 2,486 stations. Watch the star: TGV, Intercités and TER all converge on Paris, a layout set in 1842 when the network was planned from the capital outward. The country wakes before dawn and empties again after midnight 🌙

📊 Data: SNCF Voyageurs GTFS, transport.data.gouv.fr (Licence Ouverte), Thursday 3 September 2026. Positions interpolated between stops; stations joined in straight lines.
